name: Box
description: Typed Box API 2.0 files, folders, search, bounded uploads/downloads, versions, comments, collaborations, shared links, users and metadata.

permissions.description: Fixed Box API/upload HTTPS; externally issued OAuth access token. One bounded unauthenticated official download hop. Explicit confirmed mutations can upload, delete, copy, share, comment and change collaboration/metadata. No filesystem, refresh, listeners or retries. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.name: Box Get File (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Get File: GET /2.0/files/{fileId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.documentation:
Box Get Folder: GET /2.0/folders/{folderId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.documentation:
Box List Folder Items: GET /2.0/folders/{folderId}/items. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. definitions.name: Box Search Content (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Search Content: GET /2.0/search. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Update file (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Update file: PUT /2.0/files/{fileId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-UPDATE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Copy file (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Copy file: POST /2.0/files/{fileId}/copy. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-COPY"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Delete file (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Delete file: DELETE /2.0/files/{fileId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-DELETE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Set file Shared Link (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Set file Shared Link: PUT /2.0/files/{fileId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-SHARED-LINK-SET"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Remove file Shared Link (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Remove file Shared Link: PUT /2.0/files/{fileId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-SHARED-LINK-REMOVE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.documentation:
Box List file Collaborations: GET /2.0/files/{fileId}/collaborations. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box List file Metadata (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box List file Metadata: GET /2.0/files/{fileId}/metadata. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Get file Metadata (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Get file Metadata: GET /2.0/files/{fileId}/metadata/{scope}/{templateKey}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Create file Metadata (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Create file Metadata: POST /2.0/files/{fileId}/metadata/{scope}/{templateKey}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-METADATA-CREATE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Box Update file Metadata (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Update file Metadata: PUT /2.0/files/{fileId}/metadata/{scope}/{templateKey}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-METADATA-UPDATE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Box Delete file Metadata (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Delete file Metadata: DELETE /2.0/files/{fileId}/metadata/{scope}/{templateKey}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-METADATA-DELETE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Update folder (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Update folder: PUT /2.0/folders/{folderId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FOLDER-UPDATE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Copy folder (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Copy folder: POST /2.0/folders/{folderId}/copy. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FOLDER-COPY"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.documentation:
Box Delete folder: DELETE /2.0/folders/{folderId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FOLDER-DELETE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Set folder Shared Link (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Set folder Shared Link: PUT /2.0/folders/{folderId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FOLDER-SHARED-LINK-SET"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Remove folder Shared Link (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Remove folder Shared Link: PUT /2.0/folders/{folderId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FOLDER-SHARED-LINK-REMOVE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.documentation:
Box List folder Collaborations: GET /2.0/folders/{folderId}/collaborations. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box List folder Metadata (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box List folder Metadata: GET /2.0/folders/{folderId}/metadata. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.documentation:
Box Get folder Metadata: GET /2.0/folders/{folderId}/metadata/{scope}/{templateKey}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.documentation:
Box Create folder Metadata: POST /2.0/folders/{folderId}/metadata/{scope}/{templateKey}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FOLDER-METADATA-CREATE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Update folder Metadata (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Update folder Metadata: PUT /2.0/folders/{folderId}/metadata/{scope}/{templateKey}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FOLDER-METADATA-UPDATE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

Box Delete folder Metadata: DELETE /2.0/folders/{folderId}/metadata/{scope}/{templateKey}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FOLDER-METADATA-DELETE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. definitions.documentation:
Box Create Folder: POST /2.0/folders. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FOLDER-CREATE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. definitions.documentation:
Box Upload File: POST /2.0/files/content. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-UPLOAD"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Upload File Version (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Upload File Version: POST /2.0/files/{fileId}/content. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX FILE-UPLOAD-VERSION"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Download File (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Download File: GET /2.0/files/{fileId}/content. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box List File Versions (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box List File Versions: GET /2.0/files/{fileId}/versions. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Get File Version (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Get File Version: GET /2.0/files/{fileId}/versions/{versionId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Promote File Version (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Promote File Version: POST /2.0/files/{fileId}/versions/current. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX VERSION-PROMOTE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Delete File Version (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Delete File Version: DELETE /2.0/files/{fileId}/versions/{versionId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX VERSION-DELETE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.documentation:
Box List File Comments: GET /2.0/files/{fileId}/comments. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Update Comment (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Update Comment: PUT /2.0/comments/{commentId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX COMMENT-UPDATE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Box Delete Comment: DELETE /2.0/comments/{commentId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX COMMENT-DELETE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Get Collaboration (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Get Collaboration: GET /2.0/collaborations/{collaborationId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Create Collaboration (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Create Collaboration: POST /2.0/collaborations. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX COLLABORATION-CREATE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box Update Collaboration (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Update Collaboration: PUT /2.0/collaborations/{collaborationId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX COLLABORATION-UPDATE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.
