definitions.name: Box Remove Collaboration (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box Remove Collaboration: DELETE /2.0/collaborations/{collaborationId}. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="BOX COLLABORATION-DELETE"; mutations may have side effects. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

definitions.name: Box List Enterprise Users (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Box List Enterprise Users: GET /2.0/users. Fixed official api.box.com or upload.box.com HTTPS; no custom URL. Externally issued OAuth token via BOX_ACCESS_TOKEN/tokenSecret, or builtin $connection selecting RuntimeConnection.config plus credentials.accessToken. Retries must be zero; reconcile uncertain results before repeating. One explicit bounded page, limit defaults100/max1000; marker/offset inputs, no auto pagination. File/folder/web_link and user/group resources are typed tagged unions. Decimal uint64 strings preserve large sizes/quotas; metadata has known system fields and genuinely variable scalar/list values. Unknown provider fields omitted. Default10s/max30s total deadline begins before profile/secrets; dispatch/read/synchronous result/final success guarded, abort and cleanup bounded100ms. Strict UTF-16 and fatal UTF-8. Request512KiB, JSON1MiB, content256KiB. Multipart attributes precede file, no streaming/chunked upload sessions. Download allows one validated exact dl.boxcloud.com /d/ redirect without Authorization; all further redirects fail. Links returned only. No JWT/token refresh, impersonation, listeners, destructive recursive traversal, retries or real provider validation. Metadata requires appropriate plan/templates and scope global/enterprise; JSON Patch operations explicit. Sources: https://developer.box.com/reference/ https://developer.box.com/reference/get-folders-id-items https://developer.box.com/reference/get-search https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/get-files-id-content https://developer.box.com/reference/post-collaborations https://developer.box.com/reference/put-files-id-metadata-id-id https://developer.box.com/reference/get-users-me https://developer.box.com/guides/authentication/

Canonical relay contract onf.business.v1 is documented in the package ingress setup. The relay must verify the original provider, persist/normalize the event and then authenticate its HTTPS POST with a separate ONF header token. The decoder never sees provider headers and does not verify provider signatures. Only selected resource fields are emitted. Filters scopeId/resourceId are exact matches. Deduplication keeps the last 64 scoped event IDs and checkpoints on trigger success before downstream completion. Repeated older deliveries can run again; downstream operations must be idempotent. No subscription, relay or secret is provisioned by installation. Provider setup: Verify BOX-SIGNATURE-PRIMARY or BOX-SIGNATURE-SECONDARY using base64 HMAC-SHA256 over exact raw body bytes followed by BOX-DELIVERY-TIMESTAMP bytes with the corresponding key; validate signature version/algorithm and a ten-minute timestamp age. This is not a raw-body hex signature. Use body.id as eventId, not BOX-DELIVERY-ID, which changes on retries; scopeId is webhook.id and resourceId is source.id. Map trigger to the canonical eventType unchanged; allowlist configured target and webhook.

Saved entry setup: explicitly select webhook mode, configure the inspector fields, select a profile belonging to this exact installed package requirement, and save the node. Package metadata does not infer entry mode or provision/bind a profile. Enable workflow and entry only after deliberate setup.

ingressRequirements.name: Box verified event relay
ingressRequirements.description: Box timestamp-signed webhook relay. Accepts the canonical onf.business.v1 envelope only; an external provider-aware relay is required.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.

Verify BOX-SIGNATURE-PRIMARY or BOX-SIGNATURE-SECONDARY using base64 HMAC-SHA256 over exact raw body bytes followed by BOX-DELIVERY-TIMESTAMP bytes with the corresponding key; validate signature version/algorithm and a ten-minute timestamp age. This is not a raw-body hex signature.

Use body.id as eventId, not BOX-DELIVERY-ID, which changes on retries; scopeId is webhook.id and resourceId is source.id. Map trigger to the canonical eventType unchanged; allowlist configured target and webhook.

Emit canonical JSON {contract:"onf.business.v1",provider:"box",eventType,eventId,scopeId,resourceId,occurredAt,resource}; occurredAt and nullable resource fields must explicitly be null when unavailable. The resource fields and eventType are defined by the selected trigger schema. Preserve eventId across relay retries.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-provider-relay"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.
